name: wikipedia-context-benchmark
description: A benchmark of tasks that use Wikipedia passages as context to evaluate models' ability to retrieve and use factual context for downstream text tasks. Typically contains queries paired with supporting Wikipedia context and target outputs to test retrieval-augmented generation and context-aware question answering. Useful for measuring how well models leverage external encyclopedic context.
reputation: Small/experimental dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside exploratory evaluations.
